name: mm-mcp
description: Read, search and post in Mattermost as yourself, through the mm-mcp server, with a skill that logs you in, single sign-on included. Needs mm-mcp installed: https://vriesdemichael.github.io/mm-mcp/installation/

mm_url.title: Mattermost address
mm_url.description: The address you open Mattermost at, such as https://chat.example.com.

mm_token.title: Token
mm_token.description: A personal access token or a bot token. Leave it empty after logging in once with mm-mcp login, which keeps your session in your system's credential store.

allow_writes.title: Allow posting
allow_writes.description: Offer the tools that post and change things. Each change others see asks you first.
